quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #24
										  					
  

25 Questions • Passing Score 19

questions.question: What is the first thing you should adjust when you get into a car to drive?

options.text: Your seat belt
The steering wheel
Your rearview mirror
Your seat

questions.correctAnswerText: Your seat
questions.explanation: Adjust your seat first so you are comfortable and can see the road clearly. Then adjust your mirrors and steering wheel after your seat is set.

questions.question: A solid red arrow on a traffic signal means:

options.text: It is never used as a traffic signal.
It means the same thing as a red circular traffic light.
Drivers may turn in the direction the arrow points.
Traffic in that direction must stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: It means the same thing as a red circular traffic light.
questions.explanation: A solid red arrow means the same as a red circular light. You must stop and cannot turn in the direction the arrow points.

questions.question: A driver's left arm and hand extended downward is a hand signal that means:

options.text: Turn left.
Turn right.
Stop.
Start up.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop.
questions.explanation: A left arm and hand extended downward means the driver is going to stop. Adjust your driving if you see this signal from the car ahead of you.

questions.question: When merging onto a freeway, you should:

options.text: Go slowly and wait for an opening.
Go faster than freeway traffic.
Turn on your hazard lights until you are safely on the freeway.
Speed up to match freeway traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Speed up to match freeway traffic.
questions.explanation: Use the on-ramp to speed up to the same speed as freeway traffic. This helps you blend in smoothly and safely. You must yield to traffic already on the freeway.

questions.question: What is the best way to stay safe when backing your vehicle?

options.text: Honk your horn right before shifting into reverse.
Check behind the vehicle before you get in the driver's seat.
Check your rearview mirrors.
Turn up the car radio to get attention.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check behind the vehicle before you get in the driver's seat.
questions.explanation: Backing is dangerous because you cannot see well behind your vehicle. Before you get in to back up, walk around and check for children or small objects behind the car.

questions.question: If your car starts to skid, turn your steering wheel:

options.text: To keep the front wheels straight.
In the direction you want the vehicle to go.
In the opposite direction of the skid.
In any direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: In the direction you want the vehicle to go.
questions.explanation: If your vehicle skids, steer in the direction you want it to go. Once the vehicle straightens out, turn the wheel back the other way.

questions.question: You may not cross a single broken white or yellow line:

options.text: When doing so would interfere with traffic.
When turning left into a driveway.
When the car in front of you is disabled.
When passing to the right on a one-way street.

questions.correctAnswerText: When doing so would interfere with traffic.
questions.explanation: You can cross a single broken line to pass or change lanes if it is safe and does not interfere with other traffic.

questions.question: Signs for public recreation areas are:

options.text: Orange.
Red.
Green.
Brown.

questions.correctAnswerText: Brown.
questions.explanation: Brown signs show areas with cultural, historical, or recreational value. They are helpful when traveling in unfamiliar areas.

questions.question: The light is green but you want to turn left into heavy oncoming traffic. You should:

options.text: Use the next intersection.
Wait at the crosswalk for traffic to clear.
Wait in the center of the intersection for traffic to clear.
Turn because you have a green light.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait in the center of the intersection for traffic to clear.
questions.explanation: When turning left with heavy oncoming traffic, you can enter the intersection when the light is green. Wait in the center of the intersection for the oncoming traffic to pass before you complete your turn.

questions.question: On a vertical traffic light, the colors from top to bottom are:

options.text: Red, yellow, green.
Red, green, yellow.
Green, red, yellow.
Green, yellow, red.

questions.correctAnswerText: Red, yellow, green.
questions.explanation: On a vertical traffic light, red is always on top, yellow in the middle, and green on the bottom. On a horizontal light, red is on the left and green is on the right.

questions.question: If an oncoming driver is heading toward you in your lane, what should you do?

options.text: Honk your horn, steer right, and speed up.
Honk your horn, steer left, and brake.
Honk your horn, steer right, and brake.
Stay in your lane, honk your horn, and brake.

questions.correctAnswerText: Honk your horn, steer right, and brake.
questions.explanation: First, honk to get the other driver's attention. If they don't move, steer right to escape. Don't steer left—the other driver might correct at the last second and you will still crash. If a crash cannot be avoided, brake hard and steady. Every mile per hour you slow down reduces the crash impact.

questions.question: When driving to a place you don't know, you should:

options.text: Rely on road signs to find your way.
Plan your trip before you leave.
Just have a general idea of where you're going.
Always take the most direct route.

questions.correctAnswerText: Plan your trip before you leave.
questions.explanation: Plan your trip before you start driving. Don't leave with only a vague idea of where you're going. Check a map to find your destination before you drive.

questions.question: A red flashing traffic light means the same thing as a:

options.text: Solid red light.
Stop sign.
Yield sign.
Caution sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop sign.
questions.explanation: A red flashing traffic light means you must stop completely, just like a stop sign. Come to a full stop and proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What should you do when you approach a railroad crossing without traffic signals?

options.text: Always come to a complete stop.
Slow down and be ready to stop.
All railroad crossings have signals, so this will never happen.
Speed up to cross the tracks quickly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: At an unmarked railroad crossing, slow down and be prepared to stop. Look both ways on all tracks to make sure no trains are coming. If you see or hear a train, stop at a safe distance and wait until it passes before crossing.

questions.question: When exiting a highway, when should you start to slow down?

options.text: On the main road, just before the exit lane.
Once you see a toll booth.
After you move into the exit lane.
When you first see the exit sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: After you move into the exit lane.
questions.explanation: Move into the exit lane well in advance. Do not slow down until after you are fully in the exit lane.

questions.question: When you come to a flashing red light, you must:

options.text: Slow down and drive carefully through the intersection.
Turn right or left because the road ahead is blocked.
Stop and wait for a flashing green light.
Stop, then go when it is safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop, then go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means you must stop completely. Proceed only when the way is clear and safe.

questions.question: When parallel parking between two cars, what should you do first?

options.text: Turn your wheels to the left.
Turn your wheels to the right.
Pull alongside the car in front of the parking space.
Back slowly into the space.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull alongside the car in front of the parking space.
questions.explanation: After finding a space, checking traffic, and signaling, stop parallel to the car in front of your desired parking space. Then turn your wheel to park.

questions.question: Guide signs are ____ signs that show directions and distances to destinations.

options.text: Yellow
Red
Green
White

questions.correctAnswerText: Green
questions.explanation: Guide signs have a green background and show directions and distances to specific places. They are helpful when driving in unfamiliar areas.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Narrow bridge ahead.
Lane ends or road narrows ahead.
Industrial area.
Freeway on-ramp ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane ends or road narrows ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns that the right lane is ending or the road is getting narrower.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Stop.
No U-turn.
Yield.
Do not enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do not enter.
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you that you cannot continue driving in your current direction.

questions.question: When parking uphill next to a curb, set the parking brake and:

options.text: Keep the rear tires against the curb.
Keep the front tires straight ahead.
Turn your steering wheel away from the curb.
Turn your steering wheel toward the curb.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your steering wheel away from the curb.
questions.explanation: Turn your steering wheel away from the curb when parking uphill. If your car rolls, it will roll into the curb and stop.

questions.question: When driving on slippery roads:

options.text: Always drive at the maximum speed limit.
Use cruise control to maintain a steady speed.
Reduce your following distance.
Do not make any sudden changes in speed or direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do not make any sudden changes in speed or direction.
questions.explanation: Avoid sudden changes in speed or direction on slippery roads. Slow down and do not use cruise control.

questions.question: A solid yellow arrow on a traffic signal means:

options.text: It is never used as a traffic signal.
It has the same meaning as a yellow circular light.
Drivers may turn in the direction shown by the arrow.
A green arrow will appear next.

questions.correctAnswerText: It has the same meaning as a yellow circular light.
questions.explanation: A solid yellow arrow means the same as a yellow traffic light. Slow down and get ready for a red light.

questions.question: Your vehicle stops longer when stopping on:

options.text: A wet or icy road.
Paved highways.
At night.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: A wet or icy road.
questions.explanation: Stopping distance increases on wet or icy roads. It also increases on loose gravel or stones.

questions.question: You may cross solid yellow lines:

options.text: To pass traffic moving in the same direction.
During daylight hours only.
At any time.
When making turns.

questions.correctAnswerText: When making turns.
questions.explanation: Broken lines can be crossed. Solid yellow lines can only be crossed when turning.
